scope: BookiE B4-22 confirmed connection-bundle import audit
assertions: The GTK welcome-view import action opens the import chooser and the user selects a plaintext bundle.
The import preview is shown before the selected connection is written.
Confirming the preview saves the selected connection and preserves unmentioned local connections.
The durable audit journal contains exactly one intent and one outcome with the same operation ID.
The outcome is succeeded and both records contain only the aggregate affected count.
The records use the fixed local_settings identity and nil connection ID.
The imported bundle path and connection name are absent from both audit records.
not_established: Encrypted bundle unlock and credential replacement in the GTK flow.
